description: This file defines the KamonCounter class, an implementation of a Counter interface, which integrates with Kamon metrics library to provide counter functionalities such as incrementing, tagging, and resetting counters.

classes.name: KamonCounter
classes.description: A final class implementing the Counter interface, providing Kamon-based metric counting with tagging and reset capabilities.

methods.name: newCounter
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new KamonCounter instance with given name and optional tags.

methods.name: tag
methods.description: Returns a new KamonCounter instance with an added tag key-value pair.

methods.name: tags
methods.description: Returns a new KamonCounter instance with multiple tags merged.

methods.name: getTag
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specific tag key.

methods.name: getTags
methods.description: Returns the current set of tags associated with the counter.

methods.name: increment
methods.description: Increments the counter by a specified long value.

methods.name: getCount
methods.description: Returns the current count snapshot of the counter.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Attempts to reset the counter value to zero.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the KamonCounter object.
